column1: # Known differences for Hamamatsu VMS: JPEG decoded with different IDCT implementations

column6: JPEG IDCT rounding; Bio-Formats reads PhysicalWidth/Height as micrometres (228 um per pixel); they are nanometres (0.228 um per pixel at 40x)

the map (Bio-Formats series 2, scopeio level 1) differs: scopeio's map matches the block means of level 0 (e.g. 156/111/137 against 158/107/136 for the cell at x 76800, y 9536), Bio-Formats' does not (206/192/180)
